title: Paid reporting year
brief: Paid work inside one reporting year, with the year's edges defined exactly rather than approximately.
instructions: Return the IDs of paid orders from 2024-01-01 00:00:00 UTC onward and strictly before 2025-01-01 00:00:00 UTC.
Include timestamps at or after 2024-01-01 00:00:00 UTC and exclude timestamps at or after 2025-01-01 00:00:00 UTC. The interval is half open.
Return only the declared columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types, and follow the stated ordering contract. NULL placement is declared, not assumed.
starterExplanation: The starter reads order_id, status and ordered_at out of orders. It runs. It does not answer the question.

hints.text: Two conditions apply: the status, and a half-open interval in time.
The lower bound is inclusive and the upper bound is not, so a closed range will not do.
Order 1 sits on the included edge; order 10 sits on the excluded one.
